name: Kisszentmárton (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kisszentmárton (a shield of white and red with Saint Martin on horseback, a church, a bunch of grapes and a heron) between oak and grain branches, above the name KISSZENTMÁRTON in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
